purpose: Source-only painted golf UI equipment art; five period-inspired visual tiers, not gameplay/technology-history assertions
common_requirements: Native transparent RGBA PNG; complete shafts/grips/heads and readable silhouettes.
Same detailed hand-painted game inventory style; daytime light from screen upper right, shadows lower left.
No brands, words, dates, logos, UI frames, grid lines, scene grounds or opaque background wash.
Clothing is unoccupied polo+trousers/skirt+shoes flat-lays, never new characters.
Period inspiration only; no claims that any material/technology was invented in a specific decade, and no gameplay statistics.

era_appearance_briefs.1980s: Warm wood-grain driver, restrained chrome clubs and simple blade putter; plain paper tee pack; pastel polos, pleated/straight bottoms and classic leather-look shoes; dark bag with brown trim.
era_appearance_briefs.1990s: Dark compact metalwood appearance, clear cavity-back iron, silver blade putter; simple coloured tee pack; block-colour polos and conservative bottoms; padded two-tone bag.
era_appearance_briefs.2000s: Larger silvery metal driver appearance, broader cavity iron and rounded mallet; bolder packaged tees; sporty panel/stripe apparel details and clean neutral bottoms; structured carry/stand bag.
era_appearance_briefs.2010s: Black/white aerodynamic-looking driver, clean geometric iron inset and broad mallet; bright accent tee pack; blue/coral sport polos with coordinated shoes; blue/white bag with restrained bright trim.
era_appearance_briefs.2020s: Sleek matte-black/carbon-look forms, restrained muted accents and clean premium club silhouettes; coordinated modern tee pack, streamlined outfit flat-lays and contemporary carry-bag styling.

status: Allfive era source designs generated and selected as source candidates;2010v2chosen after native transparency correction; no game integration.
